blocks.text: Ionizing radiation istemal karne wale imaging ke tareeqe is baat par chalte hain ke radiation matter se kaise interaction karti hai: tissue se guzarte photons absorb (jazb) ya scatter (bikhar) ho sakte hain, aur energy deposition (energy ke jama hone) aur attenuation (kamzor hone) ka yahi pattern detector par measurable (naapne ke qabil) signal banata hai. Nuclear medicine mein radiation mareez ke andar se aati hai, ek di gayi radioactive dawa (radiopharmaceutical) se. Is liye signal body ki anatomy (shakal aur banawat) se zyada us ka physiological function (kaam) dikhata hai. Ek important functional technique SPECT (Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography) hai: gamma rays chhorne wala tracer body mein dala jata hai aur ghoomta hua gamma camera mukhtalif directions se bohat si projection views (tasveerein) leta hai. In se tracer distribution (tracer kahan kitna phaila) ki cross-sectional images banai jati hain, jo perfusion (khoon ke pohanchne) aur organs ke function ki 3D information deti hain. PET (Positron Emission Tomography) isi idea ko positron chhorne wale tracers se aage barhata hai: positron tissue mein thora sa faasla tay kar ke ek electron se mil kar annihilate (dono khatam) hota hai aur do gamma photons taqreeban opposite (ulti) directions mein nikalte hain. In dono photons ko coincidence (ek hi lamhe) mein detect kar ke machine event (waqiye) ki location maloom karti hai aur tracer uptake (tracer ke jama hone) ka quantitative map (naqsha) banati hai. Is liye PET non-invasive technique hai jo cell/molecule ki level par metabolic aur biochemical activity (sargarmi) ki image banata hai. Yeh cancer ki early detection (jaldi pehchan) aur staging (stage maloom karna), brain (dimagh) ke function ki jaanch aur dil ki abnormalities (kharabiyon) ko wazeh anatomical (banawati) tabdeeli se pehle pakarne ke liye bohat valuable (qeemti) hai (Fig. 20.10, PET scanner ki image).

blocks.alt: PET scanner. Baen taraf PET machine, aik bari khari gantry jis ke beech gol surakh hai aur oopar chhota monitor. Daen taraf rotating scanner ka bazu screen ke saath. Mareez motorized exam table par leta hai jo surakh ke andar jati hai aur oonche base par khari hai. Oopar daen: Brain Scan, brain ke rangeen sections aur colour scale.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.10: PET-scanner ki tasveer (kitab ki Figure 20.10 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mareez motorized exam table par leta hai aur table use PET machine ke gol surakh mein le jati hai. Machine ki ring ke detectors body se nikalne wali gamma rays pakarte hain, aur computer un se Brain Scan jaisi rangeen tasveer banata hai jis mein zyada active hissay alag rang mein nazar aate hain.
PET scan ka working (PET scan kaise kaam karta hai)

PET scanning machine ka schematic diagram (saada khaaka) Fig. 20.11 mein hai. PET scan mein radioactive tracer ki thora sa amount (miqdar) vein (nas) mein inject ki jati hai. Blood (khoon) tracer ko le jata hai aur yeh zyada active (sargarm) tissues mein zyada jama hota hai, jaise bohat se cancers ya brain aur dil ke kaam karte hisse. Tracer ke unstable nuclei decay (toot) hote hue positrons chhorte hain. Har positron thora sa faasla tay kar ke qareeb ke tissue ke electron se milta hai. Milne par positron aur electron annihilate hote hain aur un ka mass energy ban kar do gamma-ray photons ki shakal mein opposite directions mein nikalta hai. Mareez ke gird ring mein lage detectors in photon pairs (joron) ko detect kar ke signals computer ko bhejte hain, jo saaf images banata hai ke tracer kahan jama hua. PET image ke zyada bright (roshan) hisse zyada tracer concentration, yani zyada tissue activity, dikhate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: positron emitter, ek atom jis ka nucleus electrons ke darmiyan positron chhorta hai; positron electron se mil kar annihilate (khatam) hota hai aur do gamma-rays opposite directions mein bhejta hai. Darmiyan: PET scanner ki ring, couch par mareez aur mareez se ring tak gamma-rays. Ek mura hua arrow daen taraf computer display tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.11: PET scanning ka schematic diagram (kitab ki Figure 20.11 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tracer ka nucleus positron chhorta hai; positron qareeb ke electron se mil kar khatam hota hai aur 0.51 MeV ki do gamma rays opposite directions mein nikalti hain. Scanner ki ring dono ko ek saath detect karti hai aur computer image banata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 20.11 mein 'Nuctrus' (sahi: Nucleus) aur 'Y-RAYS' (sahi: γ-rays, yani gamma-rays) chhapa hai, aur 'Positron-electron annihilation' ka label scanner se computer wale arrow par likha hai. Annihilation mareez ki body ke andar hota hai, is liye hamari drawing mein yeh label annihilation ke point par hai.

Medical physics cancer ki diagnosis aur treatment mein bhi bohat important hai, khaas taur par radiotherapy mein. Radiotherapy high energy radiation se tumour ke cells ko maarti hai aur healthy (sehatmand) tissues ko kam se kam nuqsan deti hai. (Kitab 'high energy particles' likhti hai; zyada tar yeh high energy X-rays ya gamma rays hoti hain.) Radiation therapy ke do main (bare) tareeqe hain: teletherapy, jis mein radiation body ke bahar rakhi machine se di jati hai, aur brachytherapy, jis mein radioactive source tumour ke andar ya bilkul qareeb rakha jata hai.

Medical physicists bhi oncology (cancer ke ilaj ki) team ka hissa hain. Yeh equipment (machinon) ki quality assurance (theek kaam karne ki jaanch), treatment ke time ka calculation (hisaab), treatment planning aur cancer wale hisse mein dose distribution (dose kahan kitni) ka map banane ke specialist (mahir) hote hain. Yeh radiation oncologists, dosimetrists (dose naapne wale mahir) aur laboratory technicians ke saath mil kar har treatment ko safe aur clinically effective (mareez ke liye kaamyab) banate hain.

blocks.prompt: PET scanning mein coincidence detection ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Sirf woh gamma rays ke pairs gine jate hain jo ek hi lamhe opposite detectors par pohanchein. Is liye har event (annihilation) un do detectors ko jorne wali seedhi line par hota hai. Bohat si aisi lines se annihilation ki location milti hai, aur akele (unrelated, be-talluq) photons reject (rad) ho jate hain.

items: SPECT: gamma rays chhorne wala tracer aur ghoomta hua gamma camera.
PET: tracer ka positron electron se annihilate hota hai; do gamma photons opposite directions mein, coincidence mein detect hote hain.
PET function (kaam) dikhata hai: cancer, brain, dil.
Radiotherapy: teletherapy (bahar se) aur brachytherapy (source andar ya qareeb).
